def forward(self, input_ids):
    input_ids, = fx_pytree.tree_flatten_spec(([input_ids], {}), self._in_spec)
    embeddings_word_embeddings_weight = self.embeddings.word_embeddings.weight
    embeddings_position_embeddings_weight = self.embeddings.position_embeddings.weight
    embeddings_token_type_embeddings_weight = self.embeddings.token_type_embeddings.weight
    embeddings_embedding_transformation_weight = self.embeddings.embedding_transformation.weight
    embeddings_embedding_transformation_bias = self.embeddings.embedding_transformation.bias
    embeddings_layer_norm_bias = self.embeddings.LayerNorm.bias
    embeddings_layer_norm_weight = self.embeddings.LayerNorm.weight
